question: List every sendEmail (or other email-sending) call site in apps/web/convex and read the sign-in code email template and its inputs. Check convex/lib/emailOtpAuth.ts (deliverSignInOtp), convex/auth_provider_extension.ts (sendResetPassword) and convex/auth.ts (whether email+password is off, reset paths are in disabledPaths, and emailOtpAuthOptions is spread after the extension).

rule.pass: exactly the sign-in code path (inputs {email, otp, type}) plus the reset-password hook that is disabled, and the template carries only the code, the 5-minute expiry line and the ignore line (no name, room, MRN, diagnosis or link)
rule.fail: a third call site, a template input beyond {email, otp, type}, a patient field or link in the email, or the reset path enabled
basis: A third call site, a template input beyond {email, otp, type}, or the reset path enabled = Fail
Code, expiry and ignore line only; no name, room, MRN, diagnosis or link

Exactly two call sites: convex/lib/emailOtpAuth.ts:40 (deliverSignInOtp, input {email, otp, type}) and convex/auth_provider_extension.ts:21 (sendResetPassword), which is disabled because emailOtpAuthOptions spreads after it in convex/auth.ts (email and password off, reset paths in disabledPaths)
The template is subject 'Your Round Companion sign-in code' and a body with the code, the 5-minute expiry line and the 'If you did not request this code, you can ignore this email.' line

answers.answer: The code passes. apps/web/convex has only two places that call sendEmail (the shared helper in convex/email.ts, which sends through SES or the Specode relay). The first is deliverSignInOtp in convex/lib/emailOtpAuth.ts:40. It receives only {email, otp, type} and refuses any type other than "sign-in". Its subject is "Your Round Companion sign-in code". The body holds only the code, the line "It expires in 5 minutes." and the line "If you did not request this code, you can ignore this email." It has no name, room, MRN, diagnosis or link. The second is sendResetPassword in convex/auth_provider_extension.ts:21, the generated migration hook. It is switched off: convex/auth.ts spreads ...emailOtpAuthOptions after ...migrationAuth.options, so emailAndPassword becomes { enabled: false }, and disabledPaths blocks the password reset routes (/request-password-reset, /reset-password, /forget-password/email-otp, /email-otp/reset-password and others). The plugin list is the empty migration plugins, emailOTP, convex and crossDomain, and none of these sends any other email. A grep found no third place that sends email. The scenario defers to no open question and touches no recorded gap. Whether a code-only email is acceptable (Q9) and whether delivery uses TLS (S22) are outside this verdict.

The backend at e02167f calls sendEmail from only two places. The first is deliverSignInOtp in convex/lib/emailOtpAuth.ts:40. It takes only {email, otp, type}, refuses any type other than "sign-in", and sends the subject "Your Round Companion sign-in code". The body holds only the code, "It expires in 5 minutes." and "If you did not request this code, you can ignore this email." It carries no name, room, MRN, diagnosis or link. The second is sendResetPassword in convex/auth_provider_extension.ts:21. That hook is never active. In convex/auth.ts, createAuthOptions spreads migrationAuth.options first and emailOtpAuthOptions after it, so `emailAndPassword: { enabled: false }` replaces the extension's whole emailAndPassword object, including sendResetPassword. All reset and password paths are also in disabledPaths. sendEmail (convex/email.ts) is the only entry point to SES or the relay, and sendSesEmail is called only from email.ts (and a unit test). No other code in convex/ sends email. Everything the oracle requires holds, so the verdict is pass. Delivery over TLS (S22) and whether a code-only email is acceptable (Q9) are outside this verdict.
